actionsDescriptions.inviteSupporter: Invite other supporters to the system. The invitation is recorded on the blockchain for the invited wallet address, and the interval between invitations set by the contract must be respected.
actionsDescriptions.inviteRegenerator: Activists can invite Regenerators to the system, respecting the specific activist delay.
actionsDescriptions.inviteInspector: Activists can invite Inspectors to the system, respecting the specific activist delay.
actionsDescriptions.inviteActivist: Activists can invite Activists to the system, respecting the specific activist delay.
actionsDescriptions.realizeInspection: Inspectors must evaluate the amount of trees and species of the regeneration area. How many trees, palm trees and other plants over 1m high and 3cm in diameter there is in the regenerating area? Justify your answer in the report. How many different species of those plants/trees were found? Each different species is equivalent to one unity and only trees and plants managed or planted by the regenerator should be counted. Justify your answer in the report. Max result of 200.000 trees and 300 biodiversity. Zero score means invalid inspection. NOTE: If the inspector finds something suspicous about the inspected regenerator, such as invalid area, suspicious of fake account, or if the Regenerator is not findable, inspectors are encourage to realize passing 0 as values with his justification at the report to avoid being penalized.
actionsDescriptions.acceptInspection: Inspectors must only accept inspections they are capable of performing, being aware of the safety risks and responsibilities. By accepting an inspection, inspectors agree that the they are responsible for their own safety at the data collection. It is recommended to use long sleeves clothes, hats, boots that can prevent bites from animals, gloves to protect from spines and any other useful safety equipment, such as machetes or pepper spray. Accepting an inspection counts as a 'give-up' until realized. Inspectors can only accept one open inspection at a time and cannot inspect the same regenerator twice. They must also adhere to specific delays and security windows.
actionsDescriptions.requestInspection: Regenerators agree to receive an inspector to assess their registered area. They can make an allowedInitialRequests number of requests without delay. After that, they must wait timeBetweenInspections blocks between requests. A hard limit of 6 total inspections is enforced.
actionsDescriptions.burnTokens: Compensate your environmental degradation by burning Regeneration Credit tokens. Burning tokens permanently removes them from circulation and increases your compensation certificate.

community.description: The Regeneration Credit community is made up of these seven groups. To apply to become a user, connect your wallet and fill out the required fields. The number of vacancies for each specific type is proportional to the number of registered producers, following the proportion.
community.descRegenerators: Regenerators are individuals, families, or groups providing ecosystem regeneration services to an area.
community.descInspectors: Inspectors are primarily responsible for collecting data from regenerators. and performing inspections, which may be subject to penalties for non-compliance.
community.descResearchers: Researchers are primarily responsible for the development of the project impact calculator, for the creation and improvement of evaluation methods and through submitting researches, which are subject to validation and penalty mechanisms.
community.descDevelopers: Developers are primarily responsible for the development of the project through submitting development reports, which are subject to validation and penalty mechanisms.
community.descContributors: Contributors perform generic contributions to the project and are subject to validation and penalty mechanisms.
community.descActivists: Activists are responsible for inviting new Regenerators and Inspectors, and they earn rewards based on the approval of their invited users.
community.descSupporters: Finance ecosystem regeneration, purchase Regeneration Credit directly from the community, exchange it for the certificate, and prove your commitment to the regeneration of terrestrial ecosystems.

help.title: Help
help.welcomeText: Peer-to-peer Nature regeneration system. Here are the steps to get started, the Sintrop network data and answers to the most common questions.
help.newcomerText: See how to get started, set up your wallet and register.
help.settingsLink: Getting started, network data, contract addresses and FAQ.

wallet.title: Install MetaMask
wallet.text: The app uses the MetaMask wallet to sign transactions. Install the MetaMask app and create your wallet. Keep the recovery phrase in a safe place and never share it.

network.title: Add the Sintrop network
network.text: Regeneration Credit runs on the Sintrop network. Tap the button below and approve in MetaMask: the network is added and selected, and if your wallet is not connected yet, it connects in the same step. If you prefer, add the network by hand with the data further below.

connect.title: Connect your wallet
connect.text: Tap Connect at the top of the home screen and approve in MetaMask. After approving, come back to the app.

gas.title: Buy, receive or mine SINTROP
gas.text: SINTROP is the Sintrop network unit and pays the fee of every transaction, such as registration. You can receive it from another user, copying your wallet address from your profile, or mine it with your own computer.

register.title: Register
register.text: Supporter registration is open to any wallet. The other user types need an invitation recorded on the blockchain for your wallet address. With your wallet connected, the home screen shows the registration option.

earn.title: Buy RC or provide a service
earn.text: To have credits in your wallet, buy RC from another user in the Market or provide a service to the system, such as regenerating, inspecting, researching, developing, contributing or inviting new users. Each service earns tokens from the pools every era.

token.title: See your RC in MetaMask
token.text: In MetaMask, with the Sintrop network selected, use Import token and paste the RC token contract address shown below.

help.networkText: Use this data to add the network by hand in MetaMask. Tap a field to copy it.
help.tokenText: Data to import RC into your wallet.
help.contractsText: The contracts are deployed on the Sintrop network, were audited by Nethermind Security and are open source on GitHub.

whatIs.a: It is a peer-to-peer payment for environmental services. Those who regenerate ecosystems earn Regeneration Credit (RC) tokens, and the impact behind each token is verified by a decentralized inspection process.

howEarn.a: Each user type has a pool that distributes tokens every era, in proportion to each user's level within their type. The level goes up by doing the role's work: the regenerator through the results of their area's inspections, the inspector per inspection carried out, the researcher per published research, the developer and the contributor per report, and the activist when an invited user completes their first inspections.

buy.q: How do I buy Regeneration Credit?
buy.a: Through the app's Market. It lists the offers published by users, with the amount, the price per RC, the payment method and the seller's contact. Arrange the purchase directly with the seller and give them your wallet address to receive the RC. The app does not handle the payment, so check the seller's address before paying, since names can repeat.

invite.q: Do I need an invitation to register?
invite.a: Only Supporters register without an invitation. Activists invite regenerators, inspectors and other activists. Researchers, developers and contributors are invited by users of the same type. The invitation is recorded on the blockchain for the invited wallet address, so ask for the invitation and then register with the same wallet.

sin.q: What is SINTROP and why do I need it?
sin.a: Regeneration Credit uses the Sintrop blockchain, a distributed database kept by the computers connected to the network. The computers that find blocks earn SINTROP, the network's unit of syntropy, which pays transaction fees: registration, invitations, inspections, publications, votes, withdrawals and offsets. Browsing data in the app is free. You can receive SINTROP from another user or mine it on your computer. In MetaMask the currency shows with the symbol SIN.

eras.a: The protocol is divided into eras of about 6 months. In each era, the pools distribute a fixed amount of tokens. Every 12 eras (one epoch), the emission per era is cut in half. The time until the next era is shown at the top of the home screen.

withdraw.q: How do I withdraw my tokens?
withdraw.a: In Withdraw tokens, choose the pool for your user type. The tokens of an era become available for withdrawal after it ends, according to your level in that era.

inspection.a: The regenerator requests an inspection of their area. An inspector accepts the request, visits the area within the deadline and records the tree and species counts, with photos and a report. Each inspector can inspect the same regenerator only once. The regenerator starts receiving tokens after 3 inspections by 3 different inspectors.

validation.q: Who checks that the information is true?
validation.a: Researchers, developers and contributors form the validation layer and vote to invalidate fraudulent users, inspections and publications. Each record can only be challenged during the era in which it was created.

offset.a: The supporter exchanges RC for a certificate: the tokens are burned and the certificate records on the blockchain how much verified regeneration that offset funded. If the supporter was invited, 5% of an offset made through the app goes to whoever invited them.

security.a: MetaMask is a self-custody wallet, which means only you hold the keys. The app never asks for your recovery phrase, and every transaction must be confirmed by you in MetaMask. Never share your recovery phrase with anyone.

rpc.q: The app does not load data. What should I do?
rpc.a: The app reads the blockchain through a public RPC server. If it becomes unstable, a warning appears at the top of the screen. You can switch the RPC in Settings or try again later.

mining.title: Mine SINTROP
mining.settingsText: Run a Sintrop network node on your computer and earn SINTROP for the blocks you find.
mining.introText: Regeneration Credit runs on the Sintrop blockchain, a distributed database kept by the computers connected to the network, the nodes. Each node stores a copy of every transaction and helps process new ones. The computers that find blocks are rewarded with SINTROP, the network's unit of syntropy, which also pays every transaction fee.
mining.introSmallNetwork: While the network is still small, an ordinary computer mining with its processor alone can find some blocks. That way anyone can get SINTROP for fees and register as a supporter without depending on anyone.
mining.addressConnected: The reward goes to the connected wallet. The address is already filled in the commands below.
mining.addressPaste: Paste your wallet address. It is filled in the commands below.

download.windows: On your computer, download the {{file}} file from the go-sintrop releases page.
download.ubuntu: On your computer, download the {{file}} file from the go-sintrop releases page.
download.macos: On your computer, download the {{file}} file from the go-sintrop releases page.

mining.macAppleSilicon: The macOS build runs on Macs with Apple chips (M1 or newer).

extract.ubuntu: Open Terminal and run the commands below, one at a time. Tap a command to copy it.
extract.macos: Open Terminal and run the commands below, one at a time. The last one unblocks the file, which macOS blocks because it came from the internet. Tap a command to copy it.

run.windows: In the geth.exe folder, click the address bar, type powershell and press Enter. In the PowerShell window, paste and run the command below.
run.ubuntu: In the same Terminal, paste and run the command below.
run.macos: In the same Terminal, paste and run the command below.

mining.exitText: To shut the node down safely, press Ctrl + D. Do not just close the window.
mining.rewardText: Each block found sends the reward to your address. The balance shows in My tokens. With SINTROP in your wallet you can pay fees and register as a supporter.
mining.tipComputerOn: The computer must stay on and online while mining. The longer it mines, the more chances to find blocks.
mining.tipRenewable: The Sintrop network encourages renewable energy, such as solar, wind or hydro, for mining computers.
